loading libraries
```{r, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)

library(p8105.datasets)
data("weather_df")
```
  

```{r}
dim(weather_df)
str(weather_df)
head(weather_df)
colnames(weather_df)
```
  
Let's make some scatterplots  

```{r}
ggplot(weather_df, aes(x = tmin, y=tmax)) +
  geom_point()
```


do the data frame first
```{r}
gg_temp_scatterplot <-
  weather_df |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y=tmax)) +
    geom_point()

gg_temp_scatterplot
```



make it a bit fancier

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y=tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .25) +
  geom_smooth(se=FALSE)

```

Show faceting  

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, color = name)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(. ~name)
```

```{r}

weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, color = name)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(col = vars(name))
```


Look at sth else  

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = tmax)) +
  geom_point()
```
